tex_content.html:
Lemma
1. ch8:8.14Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional inner product space, let $s\colon V\to V$ be self-adjoint, and let $C$ be the unit sphere in $V$. The function $v\mapsto \langle sv,v\rangle $ attains its maximum at some $v_0\in C$, and every maximizer is an eigenvector of $s$ with eigenvalue $\lambda _0=\langle sv_0,v_0\rangle $.
